name: dsh-skill-panel
description: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: lists global and per-project skills, toggles model and command invocation per scope, views and edits SKILL.md, and creates, imports or deletes skills.

compatibility.note: Host half uses ctx.webServer.register (top-level inject, so routes register once the carrier exists) and ctx.get('workspaceRegistry') optionally for the project picker. Client half uses the settings.section slot. Skill roots and the frontmatter contract mirror @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem.
